limitations: Headless application save/PDF reopening only; no interactive editability, repair-dialog, playback or calibrated visual-fidelity claim.

A word-spacing marker mismatch is not proof of absent node text: extraction can split words over lines. Whitespace-insensitive matches are separate lexical evidence, not legibility or geometry validation; repeated/overlapping markers do not prove distinct visible occurrences.
Native source/model losses and unmatched PDF text are observations, not silently accepted compatibility passes.
The development LibreOffice runtime does not establish stable LibreOffice or PowerPoint support.
Third-party component payloads and resulting artifacts remain local; native family admission remains incomplete.
